info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Analytics REST Change Events SObject Describe API
Salesforce Sales Cloud Describe an sObject

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the sObject (e.g., Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity)

items.docs: Completely describes the individual metadata at all levels for the specified object. Returns metadata including fields, child relationships, record type mappings, and other object-level attributes.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Get sObject page layouts

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the sObject (e.g., Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity)

items.docs: Returns a list of layouts and descriptions, including for publisher actions, for the specified sObject.
